Original English: The ship is back in Near-Harbour Lane.
Revised English: The ship returns to the Harbour Route.

Chinese key: 回近港我喜欢。港口的灯还认得我们。
Original English: I like going back to Near-Harbour. The harbour lights still know us.
Revised English: I like coming back to the Harbour Route. I recognise the lights here.

Chinese key: 几乎没有航标。星星最密，适合什么也不做。
Original English: There are almost no beacons here. The stars are at their thickest. It's a good place to do nothing.
Revised English: There are almost no beacons here. The stars are especially bright.

Chinese key: 这是一串坐标。没人知道是哪里的。
Original English: These are coordinates. Nobody knows where they point.
Revised English: These are coordinates, but nobody knows where they lead.

Chinese key:
这一班没有特别的信。
附一张空白明信片，背面还没写过字。
Original English:
There's nothing particular on this run.
I've put in a blank postcard. Nothing has been written on the back of it yet.
Revised English:
There's no news on this mail run.
I've included a blank postcard in case you need one.

Chinese key:
空着的格子也是一拍。
发条往一个方向拧，拧多少圈，它就转多少遍。
Original English:
An empty square is a beat too.
The spring only winds one way. However many turns you give it, that's how many times it plays.
Revised English:
An empty square is still a beat.
The crank only turns one way. Each full turn plays the tune once.

Chinese key:
各航道情况如下：
近港航道，灯多。星云浅湾，三色航标都有。环带慢道，节奏稳。
静默段夜里最安静，适合不说话。
Original English:
Here is how the lanes are tonight.
Near-Harbour Lane has plenty of lights. Nebula Shallows has beacons in all three colours. Ringbelt Slow Lane keeps a steady rhythm.
The Quiet Stretch is quietest at night. It is a good place for not talking.
Revised English:
Here are tonight's route conditions.
The Harbour Route has plenty of lights. Nebula Shallows has beacons in all three colours. The Ring Route has a steady rhythm.
The Quiet Stretch is especially quiet at night.

Chinese key:
我种的月铃今天响了一声，就一声。
我站着没动，等了很久，它没再响。
我猜它要的就是这个。
Original English:
My moonbell rang once today. Just the once.
I stood still and waited a long time, and it didn't ring again.
Maybe once was all it wanted to do.
Revised English:
My moonbell rang once today.
I stayed for a while, but it didn't ring again.
I think that's all it was going to do.

Chinese key:
前几天在舷窗外看见你们的船了。
你们的窗是暖色的。我们的也是。
就写这些。
Original English:
I saw your ship out of the porthole a few days ago.
Your windows are a warm colour. So are ours.
That's all I wanted to say.
Revised English:
I saw your ship through the window a few days ago.
Your windows looked warm. Ours do, too.
That's all for now.

Chinese key: 水开了。蒸汽扑上舷窗，起了一层雾。
Original English: The water boils. Steam hits the porthole and fogs it over.
Revised English: The water boils. Steam fogs up the porthole.

Chinese key: 在面团上左右来回拖，慢慢揉。
Original English: Drag back and forth across the dough. Knead slowly.
Revised English: Drag back and forth over the dough to knead it.

Original English: That's kneaded. Now pick a shape.
Revised English: The dough is ready. Choose a shape.

Chinese key: 发酵箱里的面团发好了。
Original English: The dough in the rising box has risen.

Revised English: The bread has just started baking.

Chinese key: 架子上空着。面团烤好了会放在这里。
Original English: The rack is empty. Bread goes here once it's baked.
Revised English: Fresh bread will go on this rack when it's ready.

Chinese key: 舱灯开着的时候，窗玻璃上只映得出舱里的东西。
Original English: With the lamp on, the glass only shows the room behind you.
Revised English: When the cabin light is on, all you can see in the window is its reflection.

Chinese key: 灯暗了一档。窗外的星星浮出来一些。
Original English: The lamp goes down one step. Some of the stars outside come up.
Revised English: The lamp dims. You can see more stars outside.

Chinese key: 灯熄了。窗外的东西一下子清楚了。
Original English: The lamp is out. Everything outside comes clear at once.
Revised English: The lamp goes out. The view outside becomes clearer.

Chinese key: 灯亮了。倒影又回到玻璃上。
Original English: The lamp is on. The reflection comes back to the glass.
Revised English: The lamp comes on, and its reflection returns to the glass.

Chinese key: 玻璃上只有舱里的倒影，看不清外面。
Original English: The glass only shows the room. You can't see out.
Revised English: The cabin light is reflected in the glass. Turn it down to see outside.

Chinese key: 窗外有一盏灯在闪。闪{0}下，停一停。
Original English: A light is blinking outside. It blinks {0}, then stops for a moment.
Revised English: A light is blinking outside. It flashes {0}, then pauses.

Chinese key: 它每轮闪{0}下。提灯底座上也有刻痕。
Original English: It blinks {0} each round. There are notches on the lantern base too.
Revised English: The light flashes {0}, then pauses. Match the pattern using the notches on the lantern base.

Chinese key: 提灯转到{0}那一格。底座上有{1}道刻痕。
Original English: The lantern turns to {0}. There are {1} notches on the base.
Revised English: The lantern is set to {0}. It flashes {1} before each pause.

Chinese key: 这盏已经回过你了。它的光现在是稳的。
Original English: This one has already answered you. Its light is steady now.
Revised English: This light has already answered. It's glowing steadily now.

Chinese key: 温室比你看见的长。按住不放，可以往两边走。
Original English: The greenhouse is longer than what you can see. Hold and drag to walk along it.
Revised English: The greenhouse extends beyond the screen. Drag sideways to see the rest.

Chinese key: 种在第 {0} 个盆里。它们长得慢。
Original English: Planted in pot {0}. They grow slowly.
Revised English: The seed is planted in pot {0}.

Chinese key: 土是干的。它停着，在等水。
Original English: The soil is dry. It has stopped, waiting for water.
Revised English: The soil is dry. Water the plant to help it grow.

Chinese key: 生长灯亮了，粉色的光。植物在这种光下长得快一点。
Original English: The grow lamp comes on, pink. Plants grow faster under it.
Revised English: The grow lamp is on. Plants grow faster under it.

Original English: The leaves shut all at once.
Revised English: The leaves close as your hand passes.

Chinese key: 它们怕快。手慢一点，它们会再打开。
Original English: They don't like being rushed. Slow your hand down and they'll open again.
Revised English: Move your hand more slowly and the leaves will open again.

Chinese key: 你把花盆转了半圈。它原本朝窗那边歪，现在要重新长直。
Original English: You turn the pot half around. It had been leaning toward the window, so now it has to straighten itself again.
Revised English: The plant was leaning toward the window. It will take some time to straighten out.

Original English: The pot is turned half around.

Chinese key: 左右拖动右边的大旋钮调频。那只绿色的小眼睛合上，就是调准了。
Original English: Drag the big knob on the right to tune. When the little green eye closes, you're on it.
Revised English: Drag the large knob on the right to change stations. The green indicator closes when you're tuned in.

Chinese key: 这个频率上只有很远的沙沙声。也许现在不是时候。
Original English: There's only distant static on this frequency. Maybe it's the wrong hour.
Revised English: There's only static on this frequency. The station may broadcast later.

Chinese key: 收到了：「{0}」。台表上多了一行。
Original English: You're receiving {0}. That's one more line in the log.
Revised English: You're tuned to {0}. It's been added to the station log.

Chinese key: 台表上记了 {0} 个台，一共 {1} 行。有的台只在某些钟点出来。
Original English: You've filled in {0} of {1} lines. Some stations only come out at certain hours.
Revised English: You've found {0} of {1} stations. Some only broadcast at certain times.

Original English: There are {0} in the box now.
Revised English: There are {0} letters in the mailbox.

Chinese key: 发条只能往一个方向拧。顺着钟表走的方向转。
Original English: The spring only winds one way. Go the way a clock goes.
Revised English: Turn the crank clockwise to wind the music box.

Chinese key: 发条上了 {0} 圈。八音盒开始转。
Original English: {0} turns on the spring. The music box starts.
Revised English: You turn the crank {0} times, and the music box starts playing.

Original English: the sky: tap stars to join them

Chinese key: 小灯开着的时候，头顶只看得见最亮的那几颗。
Original English: With the small lamp on, only the brightest few show overhead.
Revised English: With the lamp on, only the brightest stars are visible.

Chinese key: 小灯熄了。先别急，眼睛要一会儿才适应。
Original English: The small lamp is out. Give it a moment. Your eyes take a while.
Revised English: Your eyes will take a moment to adjust to the dark.

Chinese key: 连上了。再点一下这颗星就停笔。
Original English: That's joined. Tap this star again to stop.
Revised English: Tap the same star again to stop drawing.

Chinese key: 线停在了空处，悬着。也许那里以后会亮起一颗星，也许不会。
Original English: The line stops on empty sky and hangs. A star may come up there later. It may not.
Revised English: The line ends in empty sky. Another star may appear there later.

Chinese key: 一根悬着的星线落在了一颗变星上
Original English: a hanging line found a variable star
Revised English: finished a star line when another star appeared

Chinese key: 船钟指着 {0}。航行第 {1} 夜。
Original English: The bell reads {0}. Night {1} of the crossing.
Revised English: The ship clock reads {0}. It's night {1} of the voyage.

Chinese key: 你在长椅上坐下。星星从窗的一边转到另一边：这艘船在自己转。
Original English: You sit down on the bench. The stars cross from one side of the window to the other. The ship is turning on itself.
Revised English: The stars drift across the window as the ship turns.

Chinese key: 坐着别动，窗外有时会经过别的东西。
Original English: Sit still a while and other things go past the window.
Revised English: Sometimes another ship passes while you sit here.

Chinese key: 发酵箱里的面团发好了，胖了一圈。
Original English: The dough in the rising box has risen, a size rounder.
Revised English: The dough has risen and looks a little bigger.
Click again to delete this saved game

Chinese key: 存在你的账户里（只有你看得见）
Original English: in your account (only you can see it)
Revised English: Saved to your account (visible only to you)

Chinese key: 暂时连不上你的账户，先存在这个浏览器里
Original English: can't reach your account right now, so it's kept in this browser
Revised English: Your account is unavailable right now. This voyage is saved in your browser.

Chinese key: 读过 {0} 封 · 寄出 {1} 张
写一件窗外看见的东西。
Original English: One thing you saw out of the window.
Revised English: Write about something you noticed outside.

Chinese key: 还没有。窗外的灯会一直经过。
Original English: Nothing yet. The lights outside keep going past.
A star-line is still left hanging.
Revised English: A star line still ends in empty sky.

Chinese key: 航程已经存好了。下次打开，船还在原处。
Original English: The crossing is saved. Open it again and the ship is where it was.

Chinese key: 空着。下一班邮船大约 {0} 靠舷。
Original English: Empty. The next mail boat comes alongside around {0}.
Revised English: The mailbox is empty. The next mail boat arrives around {0}.

Original English: the next mail boat takes it
Revised English: The next mail boat will collect it

Original English: The outgoing slot doesn't check who it's for.
Revised English: You can post a card without an address.

Chinese key: 航程存在这艘船上。下次打开，船还在原处。
Original English: The crossing is kept on the ship. Open it again and the ship is where it was.
Easier to look at in landscape
Revised English: This works better in landscape mode

Chinese key: 选一种种子。它们长得慢。
Original English: Pick a seed. They grow slowly.

Chinese key: 名字只写在这张星图上。过些天它们转回头顶的时候，名字还在。
Original English: The name goes only on this chart. It'll still be there when they come back overhead.
Revised English: The name will stay on your chart as the stars move across the sky.

Chinese key: 选"减少"以后，船身的晃动会小很多。
Original English: Reduced makes the ship's roll much smaller.
Revised English: Choose Reduced to make the ship sway less.

Chinese key: 调到 ×20，船上要等的东西都会走得快一些。正常玩请用 ×1。
Original English: At ×20 everything on the ship that has to wait runs faster. Use ×1 to play.
Revised English: At ×20, time passes twenty times faster. Use ×1 for normal play.

Chinese key: 换语言会重新载入这一页。航程已经存好，不会丢。
Original English: Changing language reloads the page. The crossing is already saved, so nothing will be lost.
Revised English: Changing the language will reload the page. Your voyage is saved.

Chinese key: 我接着。我手慢，你别松太快。
Original English: I've got it. My hands are slow, so don't let go too fast.
Revised English: I've got it. Just give me a second before you let go.

Chinese key: 我先听见你们，过了很久才看见你们。
Original English: I heard you first, and I didn't see you until much later.
Revised English: I heard your ship long before I could see it.

Chinese key: 这儿什么都慢。你说的话我也要等一等。
Original English: Everything is slow here. I've got to wait for what you say, too.
Revised English: Even your voice takes a while to reach me out here.

Chinese key: 我把它放窗台上。那扇窗朝着你们来的方向。
Original English: I'll put it on the windowsill. That window faces the way you came from.
Revised English: I'll put it by the window. It faces the way your ship came in.

Chinese key: 有船来我才敲。今晚那一下已经敲过了。
Original English: I only ring it when a ship comes. I've rung tonight's already.
Revised English: I only ring the bell when a ship comes in. I've already rung it tonight.

Chinese key: 放钟底下正好。我够不着高的地方。
Original English: Under the bell is right. I can't reach anywhere high.
Revised English: Under the bell would be perfect. I can't reach the higher part.

Chinese key: 前几天我在舷窗外看见你们了。
Original English: I saw you out the porthole a few days ago.
Revised English: I saw your ship outside my window a few days ago.

Chinese key: 我端稳了。我们温室里一直空着一个架子。
Original English: I've got it steady. There's a shelf in our greenhouse that's been empty.
Revised English: I've got it. There's an empty shelf in our greenhouse.

Chinese key: 舷门锁着。航程单上还没有下一站。
Original English: The door is locked. The run sheet has no next stop on it.
Revised English: The door is locked. Choose a destination on the bridge first.
The ship will reach {0} in about {1} minutes.

Chinese key: 船停住了。门外有脚步声，不快。
Original English: The ship has stopped. There are footsteps outside the door, and they're not quick.
Revised English: The ship has stopped. You can hear someone walking outside.

Chinese key: 架子空着。温室的台子上才装得起来。
Original English: The stand is empty. One gets built at the work bench in the greenhouse.
Revised English: Make a plant lamp at the workbench in the greenhouse.

Chinese key: 还差一道。装配台上接着做。
Original English: It needs one more step. Carry on at the work bench.
Revised English: Finish assembling the lamp at the workbench.

Chinese key: 手上空着。温室的台子上装得起来一盏。
Original English: Your hands are empty. One gets built at the work bench in the greenhouse.
Revised English: Make a plant lamp at the workbench in the greenhouse.

Original English: The lamp needs one more step.
Revised English: The lamp still needs its glass cover or light fitting.

Original English: The work bench in the greenhouse is still empty.
Revised English: There's no plant on the workbench yet.

Chinese key: 船还靠在{0}。舷门那边有人在等。
Original English: The ship is still alongside {0}. Someone is waiting at the gangway door.
Revised English: The ship is still docked at {0}. Someone is waiting by the gangway.

Chinese key: 船靠上了{0}。舷门那边有人在等。
Original English: The ship has come alongside {0}. Someone is waiting at the gangway door.
Revised English: The ship has docked at {0}. Someone is waiting by the gangway.

Chinese key: 船还靠在{0}，门外有人在等。
Original English: The ship is still alongside {0}, and someone is waiting outside the door.
Revised English: The ship is still docked at {0}. Someone is waiting outside.

Chinese key: 灯卡在罩子顶上。先有罩子。
Original English: The lamp clips into the top of a cover. The cover comes first.
Revised English: Fit the glass cover before attaching the lamp.

Chinese key: 台子上这一株还没装完。
Original English: The one on the bench isn't finished yet.
Revised English: Finish assembling the plant lamp on the workbench first.

Chinese key: 那盏装好了，在舷梯的架子上。
Original English: That one's finished. It's on the stand by the gangway.
Revised English: The finished lamp is on the stand by the gangway.

Chinese key: 这一块还空着。调度台还没叫到它。
Original English: This one's still blank. Dispatch hasn't called it yet.
Revised English: No delivery request has arrived for this destination yet.

Chinese key: 装好了。它在舷梯的架子上等着。
Original English: It's built. It's waiting on the stand by the gangway.
Revised English: The lamp is ready on the stand by the gangway.
You haven't made a delivery yet.

Chinese key: 船正靠着。先把舷门那边的事办完。
Original English: The ship is alongside. Finish what's at the gangway door first.
Revised English: Finish handing over the lamp at the gangway before choosing another destination.

Chinese key: 你在开一艘夜航船。用鼠标或者触摸点船上的东西；按 Tab 在可以碰的东西之间切换，按回车使用。
Original English: You're running a night ship. Use the mouse or touch to tap things aboard. Press Tab to move between what you can touch, and Enter to use it.
Revised English: Click or tap objects on the ship to use them. You can also press Tab to select an object, then Enter to use it.

Chinese key: 电台室：调到调度台，撕一张单子。
Original English: Radio room: tune to dispatch and tear off a slip.
Revised English: Go to the radio room. Tune to dispatch and take the printed request.

Chinese key: 驾驶舱：点航向板，选择目的地。
Original English: Bridge: tap the course board and choose a destination.
Revised English: Go to the bridge and choose a destination on the chart.

Chinese key: 温室：种一盆，浇上水，等它开花。
Original English: Greenhouse: water a planted pot and wait for it to flower.
Revised English: Plant a seed in the greenhouse. Water it and wait for it to flower.

Chinese key: 温室：走近装配台。扣上玻璃罩。接着安装灯头。
Original English: Greenhouse: move closer to the workbench. Fit the glass cover, then the lamp cap.
Revised English: Go to the workbench in the greenhouse. Fit the glass cover, then attach the lamp.

Chinese key: 舷梯：靠上以后开门，把灯递过去。
Original English: Gangway: open the door once alongside and hand the lamp over.
Revised English: Once the ship docks, open the gangway door and hand over the lamp.

Chinese key: 单子带到驾驶舱，选择目的地，船就往那边开。
Original English: Carry the slip to the bridge and put it on the course board, and the ship heads that way.
Revised English: Go to the bridge and choose the requested destination. The ship will sail there.

Chinese key: 打印口是空的。收音机调到 {0} 的调度台，委托会从这儿出来。
Original English: The slot is empty. Tune the set to dispatch at {0} and a job comes out here.
Revised English: Tune the radio to dispatch at {0} to print a delivery request.

Chinese key: 打印口空着。手上的单子先送完吧。
Original English: The slot is empty. Finish the slips in hand first.
Revised English: Finish your current deliveries before collecting another request.
There are no more delivery requests tonight.

Chinese key: 这一趟做完了。电台室会有下一张单子。
Original English: This run is finished. There's another slip waiting at the radio room.
Revised English: You've finished this delivery. Check the radio room for the next request.

Chinese key: 板子空着。单子从电台室的调度打印机出来。
Original English: The board is empty. Slips come out of the dispatch printer in the radio room.
Revised English: Get a delivery request from the printer in the radio room first.

Chinese key: 再点一次那个叉，{0} 号位就清空了。
Original English: Click that cross again and berth {0} is cleared.
Revised English: Click the cross again to delete the saved game in slot {0}.

Chinese key: 回到三个存档位那一页。这一位的航程已经存好。
Original English: Back to the page with the three berths. This voyage is already saved.
Revised English: Return to ship selection. Your progress on this ship is saved.

Chinese key: 登上一艘夜航船，为沿途的人送去一盏灯。
Original English: Come aboard a night ship and bring a light to someone along the way.
Revised English: Come aboard a night ship and deliver a lamp to someone along the way.

Chinese key: 选一个目的地，把开花植物装成灯。第一张委托和一盆月铃已经备好。
Original English: Choose a destination and make a lamp from a flowering plant. Your first request is ready. A moonbell is already in bloom.
Revised English: Your first delivery is to Old Wharf. You'll make a lamp from the flowering plant in the greenhouse.

Chinese key: 第一张委托来自旧码头。点窗间的航向板，选择目的地。
Original English: Your first request is from Old Wharf. Tap the course board between the windows to choose your destination.
Revised English: Your first delivery is to Old Wharf. Choose it on the chart between the windows.
The glass cover is in place

Chinese key: 委托已备好 · 月铃已开花
Revised English: Your moonbell is ready to use

Chinese key: 打印机里已有单子。点它取下，再到驾驶舱设定航向。
Original English: There's a request in the printer. Take it to the bridge and set your course.
Revised English: Take the request from the printer, then choose a destination on the bridge.

Chinese key: 点收音机左侧开关，再左右拖动右侧旋钮。
Original English: Tap the switch on the left of the radio. Then drag the right-hand tuning knob sideways.
Revised English: Turn on the radio, then use the knob on the right to tune.

Chinese key: 左右拖动右侧旋钮，调到 1.09。委托会从打印机出来。
Original English: Drag the right-hand knob sideways to 1.09. A request will come out of the printer.
Revised English: Turn the right-hand knob to 1.09 to receive the next request.

Chinese key: 植物已经开花。点喷壶原来的位置放下它，再选择植物。
Original English: The plant has flowered. Tap the can's original place to put it down, then choose the plant.
Revised English: Put the watering can back, then select the flowering plant.

Original English: Make a lamp from the plant
Revised English: Make a lamp from the flowering plant

Chinese key: 已有一盆开花植物。点它，选择移到装配台。
Original English: A plant is already in bloom. Tap it and choose to move it to the workbench.
Revised English: Select the flowering plant and choose Move to the workbench.

Chinese key: 植物已经放好。点装配台左边的玻璃罩。
Original English: The plant is in place. Tap the glass cover to the left of the workbench.
Revised English: Tap the glass cover to the left of the workbench.

Chinese key: 玻璃罩已经扣好。点右边灯盘上的灯头。
Original English: The cover is fitted. Tap a lamp cap in the tray on the right.
Revised English: Tap the lamp in the tray on the right.
The lamp is ready to deliver

Chinese key: 船正在前往目的地。到港时，这里会亮起提示。
Original English: The ship is on its way. This guide will show you when it arrives.
Revised English: You'll see a prompt here when the ship docks.

Chinese key: 门外有人正在等。点他，把植物灯递过去。
Original English: Someone is waiting outside. Tap them to hand over the plant lamp.
Revised English: Tap the person waiting outside to offer the lamp.

Chinese key: 船已经靠好。点舷门把手，打开门。
Original English: The ship has docked. Tap the gangway handle to open the door.
Revised English: Tap the handle to open the gangway door.

Original English: Tap the seed box and choose a seed for an empty pot.

Revised English: The plant should flower in about {0} minutes.

Original English: Tap a place you've been to, and the pencil marks it.
Revised English: Tap a place you've visited to leave a pencil mark.

On the sea chart, the ship is nearly at {0}.

Original English: On the sea chart, the ship is heading for {0}. It's about {1} minutes away.
Revised English: The ship is heading to {0}. It should arrive in about {1} minutes.

Original English: The lamp is in the hands of {0} now. Tap again to let go.

Original English: There's a porthole to the right of the gangway door. You can see out through it.
Revised English: You can still see the dock through the porthole beside the door.

Chinese key: 旧码头的灯已经换好了。今晚经过的船都看得见。
Original English: The lamp at Old Wharf has been changed. Every ship that passes tonight can see it.
Revised English: There's a new lamp at Old Wharf. Ships passing tonight can see it.

Chinese key: 回声浮标的舷窗亮着一盏灯，朝着来船的方向。
Original English: A lamp is lit in the porthole at Echo Buoy. It faces the way the ships come in.
Revised English: The lamp at Echo Buoy is lit. You can see it through the window as you approach.

Chinese key: 晚钟底下亮着一盏灯。今晚那口钟多响了一下。
Original English: A lamp is lit under the Evening Bell. The bell rang once more tonight.
Revised English: There's a lamp under Evening Bell now. The bell rang twice tonight.

Chinese key: 对面那艘船的温室窗亮了。他们还停在静默段。
Original English: The greenhouse window on the ship across is lit. They're still lying in the Quiet Stretch.
Revised English: The other ship's greenhouse window is lit. They're still in the Quiet Stretch.
